import json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

server = os.environ["TABLEAU_SERVER_URL"].rstrip("/")

    cells = table.locator("tbody tr").first.locator("td").all_inner_texts()

import json, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

app = os.environ["SIGMA_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    # Home: signed out, Sigma sends the browser to its sign-in form and back
    page.goto(app + "/alkera")
    page.fill("#login input[name=email]", "analyst@example.com")
    page.fill("#login input[name=password]", "alkera-local-ui")
    page.click("#login button[type=submit]")
    page.locator("table.documents[data-kind=workbook]").get_by_role(
        "link", name="Executive Overview", exact=True).click()
    kpis = page.locator("section[data-element]").filter(
        has=page.get_by_role("heading", name="KPIs", exact=True))
    table = kpis.locator("table.summary")
    table.wait_for()
    head = table.locator("thead th").all_inner_texts()
    cells = table.locator("tbody tr").first.locator("td").all_inner_texts()
    browser.close()
print(json.dumps({"value": dict(zip(head, cells))["Net Revenue"]}))

import csv, io, json, os
import requests

env = os.environ
base = env["SIGMA_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v2"
token = requests.post(f"{base}/auth/token", data={"grant_type": "client_credentials"},
                      auth=(env["SIGMA_CLIENT_ID"], env["SIGMA_CLIENT_SECRET"]), timeout=60)
token.raise_for_status()
s = requests.Session()
s.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token.json()["access_token"]
workbook = next(w for w in s.get(f"{base}/workbooks", timeout=60).json()["entries"]
                if w["name"] == "Executive Overview")
doc = s.get(f"{base}/workbooks/{workbook['workbookId']}", params={"includeContents": "true"},
            timeout=60).json()
element = next(e for e in doc["contents"]["elements"] if e["name"] == "Revenue by Month")
job = s.post(f"{base}/workbooks/{workbook['workbookId']}/export",
             json={"elementId": element["id"], "format": {"type": "csv"}}, timeout=120)
job.raise_for_status()
got = s.get(f"{base}/query/{job.json()['queryId']}/download", timeout=60)
got.raise_for_status()
feb = next(r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(got.text))
           if r["year"] == "2026" and r["month"] == "2")
print(json.dumps({"value": feb["Net Revenue"]}))

profiles.seed:
# commerce_analytics world seed: a shop's nightly CDC extracts -> raw -> dbt
# star schema + semantic layer -> Power BI / Tableau / Sigma dashboards.
theme: commerce_analytics    # world/world/themes/<name>/
seed: 11
vtime_start: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
# 425 nightly extracts: dt=2024-12-31 (the cutover snapshot: accounts and
# catalogue, no orders) then dt=2025-01-01 .. dt=2026-02-28. Fourteen months of
# orders, so last-year measures exist for January and February 2026. The world
# clock opens at 2026-03-02T00:00Z, a Monday - business day 1 of the February
# close.
days: 425

# Scale. Every key is optional (gen.DEFAULTS); these are the defaults, spelled
# out. Build time is dominated by dbt, not by volume - a 2x seed builds in about
# the same time.
customers: 220               # accounts on the platform at cutover
signup_pct: 18               # chance per day of a new account (a second at a quarter of it)
update_pct: 9                # chance per day that one account is upgraded a segment
orders_per_day: [20, 60]     # base range, scaled by weekday, month, peak days and growth
lines_per_order: [1, 4]
cancel_pct: 6                # 70% the same day, the rest the next day
refund_pct: 4                # 3 to 45 days after the order
growth_pct: 20               # year-over-year order volume growth
